name: Question 1
problem:
Consider the differential equation 

$$
\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x}=\frac{x+y}{x+y+2}.
$$

Using a substitution of the form $z=x+y,$ transform the differential equation into an equation of the form ${z}^{′}(x)=f(z).$ What is the function $f(z)?$

Question 1
?

Consider the differential equation dydx=x+yx+y+2. Using a substitution of the form z=x+y, transform the differential equation into an equation of the form z′(x)=f(z). What is the function f(z)?

a
2z+12z
b
2(z+1)z+2
c
2z+1z+2
d
2zz+2
e
z+12z
